summary: Bitcoin declined to approximately $75,900 on September 17 after the US Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, a landmark digital asset regulatory framework. Ethereum traded around $2,452. Crypto markets had been pressured throughout September by the Fed's return to rate hiking and the legislative setback added further uncertainty.
key_facts: BTC fell to ~$75,900 on Sep 17 after CLARITY Act Senate failure
CLARITY Act would have created comprehensive US crypto regulatory framework
ETH trading ~$2,452 on Sep 17
Crypto under pressure from Fed rate hike cycle
BTC had been near $76,000–$78,000 range in early Sep

headline: Energy stocks surge on Middle East disruptions as Iran war lifts Brent crude to $107-108
summary: Energy stocks were among the top performers in September 2026 as Iran war-related fears drove Brent crude to $107-108 per barrel in the weeks before September 18. Companies including Chevron, ExxonMobil, Shell, and TotalEnergies saw strong cash flows and shareholder returns, though Trump's latest Iran de-escalation comments provided a September 18 headwind.
key_facts: Brent at $107-108 in peak September, driven by Iran war fears
WTI fell to $101.21 on Sep 18 on Trump Iran de-escalation comments
Energy sector one of top 2026 performers
Higher oil and gas prices supported strong cash flows and buybacks
Chevron committed $7B Venezuela investment to grow output

headline: Fed Outlook 2026: Kevin Warsh signals aggressive rate path; fixed income strategies adapt
summary: iShares published an analysis noting that Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has consistently signaled an aggressive stance on inflation, with the September 2026 rate hike reinforcing this posture. Fixed income strategists recommend shorter duration positioning in a higher-for-longer rate environment, with 2-year Treasuries at 4.73% and 10-year yields above 5%.
key_facts: Fed Chair Warsh holds aggressive anti-inflation posture
10Y Treasury yield above 5% (near 19-year high)
2Y Treasury at 4.73%
30Y Treasury yield ~5.34%
Higher-for-longer rate environment: shorten fixed income duration recommended
